title: Create and update Home widgets
description: Create or revise client views from their current presentation and data contracts.
applicability: Use when asked to display a card, widget, custom view or controls in Home. An ordinary Task may need to return the document through its declared route to Home.

content.text: Choose a document, widget update or Extension from the requested experience and current client capabilities. Read the bound widget guide and the relevant live contract. Follow the data producer and presentation route when the view needs system data. Preserve existing design and state, and verify the saved or observed result that matters. Keep unobserved behavior explicit when publishing a reusable procedure.
